blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A nine-year-old boy drowned while swimming at a public beach in Sitio Bonbon, Barangay Ocaña, Carcar City, on Monday afternoon, September 28. Authorities identified the victim as alias “Kai,” 9, a resident of Sitio Baha-baha, Barangay Liburon, Carcar City. According to the Carcar City Police Station, they received a report about the drowning incident at around 5:15 p.m. Initial investigation showed that the victim had asked permission from his aunt, alias “Maria,” to join her and other children for a swim at the public beach.
